# MessageApproval (chat block)

• MessageApproval(to (static), message (static), channel? (static), detail? (static))
  - Description: A drafted message to one person that the user approves, edits or dismisses before it is sent.
  - to: Name of the person the message goes to, e.g. "Priya Sharma".
  - message: The drafted message, exactly as it would be sent.
  - channel: Where it is sent, e.g. "WhatsApp", "SMS", "Email". Defaults to "WhatsApp".
  - detail: The person's role line under their name, e.g. "Product Manager at Zepto".

MessageApproval(to, message, channel?, detail?) — a message the agent drafted for one person, shown for the user to approve; nothing is sent until they tap Send and the 8-second undo runs out. Use it for any request to message, follow up with or text someone, instead of sending anything yourself. Events: send_message {to, channel, text} once the undo window closes; dismiss_message {} on Not now. Example: msg = MessageApproval("Priya Sharma", "Hey Priya! It's been a while.", "WhatsApp", "Product Manager at Zepto")
